entity_inventory.definition: A person: a named individual human, including historical, fictional, or legendary persons referred to as individuals in the text.
An organization: a company, institution, agency, band, team, political party, or other named group with a collective identity.
A location: a country, city, region, building, facility, or geographical feature.
A point or span of time: a date, year, month, century, or named period.
A numeric quantity: a count, measurement, sum, percentage, or ranking expressed in digits or number words.
Any other named entity that is not PER, ORG, LOC, TIME, or NUM: creative works, events, laws, awards, products, languages, ethnic or religious groups, and similar referents.

merge_prohibitions.rule: Never merge entities of different schema types.

schema_front.purpose: The corpus schema as the proposer's working instructions: DocRED's closed entity-type inventory and 96-relation inventory (audit-stage profile for issue #66 stage 2; relation definitions are label-derived).
